input._script:
using JSON3, TOML, SHA, Base64
import Pkg
out = Dict{String,Any}("steps" => String[])
note(s) = (push!(out["steps"], s); nothing)
function manifest_versions(dir)
    man = TOML.parsefile(joinpath(dir, "Manifest.toml")); deps = get(man, "deps", man)
    Dict(n => get(first(es), "version", get(first(es), "uuid", "stdlib")) for (n, es) in deps)
end
shaof(f) = bytes2hex(open(sha256, f))
try
    depot = first(Base.DEPOT_PATH)
    envdir = dirname(Base.active_project())
    work = get(ENV, "WORK", "/tmp")
    bk = joinpath(work, "default-env-backup-before-JACC-1.5.1-20261121"); mkpath(bk)
    for f in ("Project.toml", "Manifest.toml", "LocalPreferences.toml"); cp(joinpath(envdir, f), joinpath(bk, f); force = true); end
    out["backup_dir"] = bk
    out["sha_before"] = Dict(f => shaof(joinpath(envdir, f)) for f in ("Project.toml", "Manifest.toml", "LocalPreferences.toml"))
    before = manifest_versions(envdir)
    out["jacc_before"] = before["JACC"]; note("backed up the three env files")

    # dry run in a copy of the env
    trial = mktempdir(work)
    for f in ("Project.toml", "Manifest.toml"); cp(joinpath(envdir, f), joinpath(trial, f)); end
    Pkg.activate(trial)
    Pkg.add(Pkg.PackageSpec(name = "JACC", version = "1.5.1"); preserve = Pkg.PRESERVE_ALL)
    after = manifest_versions(trial)
    changed = Dict(k => (get(before, k, "absent"), get(after, k, "absent")) for k in union(keys(before), keys(after)) if get(before, k, "absent") != get(after, k, "absent"))
    out["manifest_changes"] = changed
    only_jacc = all(k -> k == "JACC" || get(before, k, "absent") == "absent", keys(changed))
    out["only_jacc_changed_or_added"] = only_jacc
    out["trial_jacc"] = after["JACC"]
    if !only_jacc || after["JACC"] != "1.5.1"
        note("ABORT: the trial changed packages other than JACC or did not reach 1.5.1; real environment untouched")
    else
        # verify the installed source equals the release tree the user supplied
        tman = TOML.parsefile(joinpath(trial, "Manifest.toml")); tdeps = get(tman, "deps", tman)
        slug = Base.version_slug(Base.UUID("0979c8fe-16a4-4796-9b82-89a9f10403ea"), Base.SHA1(tdeps["JACC"][1]["git-tree-sha1"]))
        inst = joinpath(depot, "packages", "JACC", slug); out["installed_dir"] = inst
        tmp = mktempdir(work); write(joinpath(tmp, "j.tgz"), base64decode("")); run(`tar xzf $(joinpath(tmp, "j.tgz")) -C $tmp`)
        ref = joinpath(tmp, "JACC.jl-1.5.1")
        files = String[]
        for sub in ("src", "ext"), (r, _, fs) in walkdir(joinpath(ref, sub)), f in fs; push!(files, relpath(joinpath(r, f), ref)); end
        push!(files, "Project.toml")
        bad = [f for f in files if !isfile(joinpath(inst, f)) || read(joinpath(inst, f)) != read(joinpath(ref, f))]
        out["source_files_compared"] = length(files); out["source_files_different"] = bad
        rm(tmp; recursive = true, force = true)
        if !isempty(bad)
            note("ABORT: installed 1.5.1 differs from the supplied tree; real environment untouched")
        else
            note("installed JACC 1.5.1 is byte-identical to the supplied release tree (src, ext, Project.toml)")
            # commit: copy the trial Project/Manifest into the real env (LocalPreferences.toml is not touched)
            for f in ("Project.toml", "Manifest.toml"); cp(joinpath(trial, f), joinpath(envdir, f); force = true); end
            out["sha_after"] = Dict(f => shaof(joinpath(envdir, f)) for f in ("Project.toml", "Manifest.toml", "LocalPreferences.toml"))
            out["local_preferences_unchanged"] = out["sha_before"]["LocalPreferences.toml"] == out["sha_after"]["LocalPreferences.toml"]
            note("default environment now points at JACC 1.5.1")
            # remove only the JACC 1.4.0 package directories (never the one the manifest uses)
            pk = joinpath(depot, "packages", "JACC"); removed = String[]
            for d in readdir(pk)
                p = joinpath(pk, d)
                d == slug && continue
                isfile(joinpath(p, "Project.toml")) || continue
                if TOML.parsefile(joinpath(p, "Project.toml"))["version"] == "1.4.0"
                    rm(p; recursive = true, force = true); push!(removed, d)
                end
            end
            out["removed_1_4_0_dirs"] = removed
            out["jacc_dirs_after"] = Dict(d => TOML.parsefile(joinpath(pk, d, "Project.toml"))["version"] for d in readdir(pk))
            note("removed JACC 1.4.0 package directories")
        end
    end
    rm(trial; recursive = true, force = true)
catch e
    out["error"] = first(sprint(showerror, e, catch_backtrace()), 3000)
end
println(JSON3.write(out))
